name: @pipeworx/mcp-xkcd

tools.name: get_latest
tools.description: Fetch the most recently published XKCD comic. Returns comic number, title, image URL, alt/hover text, publication date, transcript (if available), and permalink.

tools.name: get_comic
tools.description: Fetch a specific XKCD comic by its number (e.g., 353 for 'Python'). Returns title, image URL, alt text, publication date, transcript, and permalink.

tools.name: random_comic
tools.description: Fetch a randomly selected XKCD comic from the full archive (skips #404). Returns comic number, title, image URL, alt text, publication date, and transcript.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-xkcd forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the xkcd pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
